name: wolfboy
description: WolfBoy checks what your code actually does against GDPR, the AI Act and CCPA, and against your own privacy policy; your own Claude Code judges each place it finds

scripts.build: node scripts/schemas-module.mjs --check && node scripts/identity-module.mjs --check && tsc -p ../schemas/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.prepack: node scripts/schemas-module.mjs --check && node scripts/shrinkwrap.mjs --check && node scripts/copy-schemas.mjs && node scripts/pack-bundle.mjs copy && node scripts/pack-plugin.mjs copy && node scripts/install-files.mjs copy && node scripts/pack-public-only.mjs
scripts.postpack: node scripts/install-files.mjs remove && node scripts/pack-plugin.mjs remove && node scripts/pack-bundle.mjs remove && node scripts/copy-schemas.mjs remove
